title: Title card
description: A full-frame explainer with four slides in one payload. A custom next hook swaps only the content, and the back() action steps backwards.

data.title: Describe the graphic in HTML
data.body: Bind data with attributes. The markup you write is the fallback when a field is missing.

data.title: Animate it with anything
data.body: in and out return a promise or a GSAP timeline. The runtime waits for it before the next command runs.

data.title: Ship one file per template
data.body: Scripts, styles and fonts are inlined, so the template loads over file:// with nothing next to it.
data.code:
$ npm run build -- --out /casparcg/template
built title-card.html
built lower-third.html

data.title: Drive it from CasparCG
data.body: ADD, UPDATE, NEXT, STOP and INVOKE map straight onto the template. JSON or the CasparCG Client's XML both work.
data.code:
CG 1-20 ADD 1 "title-card" 1 "[{…}, {…}]"
CG 1-20 NEXT 1
CG 1-20 INVOKE 1 "back"
CG 1-20 STOP 1

data.title: HTML graphics for CasparCG
data.body: One small runtime, any graphic you can build in a browser.
